$comment: Owner price approvals. The build kit's config/offer-catalog.json defines each SKU's scope and stays byte-identical; this file records what the owner approved on top of it. Scope is a product decision, price is an owner decision, and keeping them in separate files keeps it obvious which is which.

approvals.approval_note: Provisional, from docs/commercial/OFFER_PRICING.md. EUR 290 net rather than the bottom of the kit's illustrative EUR 190-590 band, because at EUR 190 a three-hour repair contributes EUR 10 and a floor has to survive the bad case. OPEN: VAT treatment is unconfirmed - the price is net and whether VAT is added depends on registration status, which must be settled before any quote reaches a customer. Effort band is an estimate; no repair has been delivered for a paying customer yet.

Provisional, from docs/commercial/OFFER_PRICING.md. EUR 190 net, creditable in full against one repair booked within 30 days; the credit caps at one repair.
